action.description: Mode: infer (default), explain, clarify, audit, or structured

context.description: Optional raw context text. When provided in infer mode, bypasses RAG and reasons directly over this text — use for live data like search results passed via {{_prev}}. Also used by clarify and audit.

limit.description: Max knowledge notes to retrieve (default: 8 for infer/explain)

store_inference.description: Persist the result as a Note (default: true, infer mode only)

available_tools.description: Tools available to the agent (clarify mode)

run_critic.description: Run adversarial critic pass to stress-test the answer and adjust confidence (structured mode only, default: false)

create_gap_tasks.description: Create Task nodes for each identified knowledge gap (structured mode only, requires store_inference=true, default: false)
